messages.subject: RE: Project Drake — SPA buyer's draft (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Buyer's response draft attached (redline). Movement: warranty cap settled at 27.5% of equity consideration (£6.16m); general claims limit at 21 months; de minimis at £30k. In return we've moved the escrow period from 18 to 24 months — the buyer is firm on this given the Phase II environmental investigation at Hamble is still open. Subject to that, we think we are very close.

James

—
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

The Tidewells will accept 27.5% and 21 months, and the £30k de minimis. On the escrow, they'll agree 24 months only if the environmental indemnity cap stays at £250k and is the sole recourse for the Hamble contamination. If you can confirm that, I think we have a deal on the key terms.

Oliver
